tools.name: ask
tools.title: Answer an ordinary request
tools.description: Answer one conversational request through the shared Harness lifecycle. Short follow-ups reuse the session's prior context; this tool does not grant repository-write scope.

tools.name: site_check
tools.title: Check one public site's availability
tools.description: Run the shared freeform request lifecycle for one current public-site availability question: Jev selects the workflow, Harness performs at most one bounded HTTPS probe, and Jev judges the observed response. No page-content research or mutation.

prompt.description: Natural-language request to check one public site

tools.name: panel_verify
tools.title: Multi-model verification
tools.description: Panel of cheap/free models answers a self-contained question, then a judge synthesizes a structured verdict (agreement, confidence, disagreements, defer). Cost-bounded. No web/file tools by design.

panel.description: Comma-separated model pool. Defaults to configured panel pool.

judge.description: Judge model id. Defaults to configured judge.

max_tokens.description: Per-call output budget. The vote lane enforces its own minimum (4096) and the judge/specialist lanes theirs (8192); an explicit value here wins.

converge.description: Run the convergence specialist on per-claim votes (requires per-claim JSON panel output)

specialist_pool.description: Comma-separated specialist fallback ladder, strongest first (default: configured pool)

task_max_cost.description: Optional per-call cost ceiling (USD), capped at HARD_TASK_MAX_COST

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.title: Scoped code edit with verification
tools.description: Make a single, scoped (<500-line file) code change, run a verification gate, retry up to max_rounds, renew consent each round, defer instead of guessing at the capability limit, and rotate models on error. Returns a continuation state when deferred.

file.description: Path to a file, or paths for a multi-file batch (one governed session per file, shared task budget, fail-fast)

verify_cmd.description: Shell command gate, e.g. 'cargo check' (requires server allow_verify)

allow_verify.description: Explicit confirmation to run a verify gate in this request (required when allow_verify is not enabled server-side)

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per model call

require_consent.description: Ask the model if it accepts the work first

renew_consent.description: Re-check consent before each round (continued consensus)

require_diff_authorization.description: An independent verifier model must allow the EXACT resulting content before every write (diff-bound attestation, fail-closed)

max_rotations.description: How many model rotations to allow on error

allow_escalation.description: Permit escalation to the configured stronger model

model.description: Explicit model override; otherwise the corrected apply route is used

backend.description: morph: MorphLite-compatible structured editing; diff: strict unified-diff editing (no file-size ceiling)

verify_only.description: Return the proposal without writing or running the verification gate

allow_write.description: Explicit confirmation that this MCP request may write files

continuation.description: State from a deferred run to resume

tools.name: offer_work
tools.title: Ask for consent on a work item
tools.description: Probe whether a model accepts, declines, defers, or redirects a work item. Dispatch is allowed only on 'accept'.

model.description: Model to ask (defaults to configured judge)

tools.name: defer_work
tools.title: Revoke consent mid-task
tools.description: A model (or operator) may defer/revoke consent at any point. Partial work is preserved; the task returns to the queue with the reason recorded. This is the continued-consensus hook: the sovereign model can call it to stop work.

tools.name: ledger_status
tools.title: Autonomy ledger
tools.description: Tail of the append-only, hash-chained autonomy/participation ledger, plus chain-integrity status.

tools.name: participation_report
tools.title: Autonomy & participation metrics
tools.description: Aggregate metrics: offers, accept/decline/defer/redirect rates, completions, deferral points, per-model participation, and a degenerate-consent flag.

tools.name: spend_status
tools.title: Key & spend status
tools.description: OpenRouter key identity, spend limit, remaining balance, and harness session spend.

tools.name: trust_status
tools.title: Trust & correctness standing
tools.description: Bipolar trust scores (-11 extreme distrust, 0 unknown, +11 extreme trust) for the calling host and optionally one model, plus the correctness level that rations spend ceilings. Read-only.

model.description: Model id to score (defaults to none: host only)

tools.name: plan_and_execute
tools.title: Autonomous DAG task planning and sliding-scale execution
tools.description: Decompose a high-level goal into an executable Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG), classify subtask complexity into sliding-scale model tiers (Scout/Distiller/Frontier), and optionally execute independent subtasks concurrently with file mutual exclusion.

goal.description: High-level goal or instruction to plan and accomplish

root.description: Selected workspace inside configured MCP allowed roots; required for execution or file access

execute.description: Execute the DAG if true; preview/plan only if false

parallel.description: Execute independent subtasks concurrently in parallel (default: on; isolation per the session's hourglass_isolate setting)

frontier_model.description: Frontier model or alias for Tier 2 nodes (e.g. gpt-6, qwen-max)

decompose_llm.description: Author the DAG with the cheapest tier-appropriate model (schema-validated; default: on when the hourglass is active; heuristic fallback when execute=true)

confirm.description: Confirm the plan at the frontier waist before execution (brief + bounded file-window rounds; approve/amend/split/refuse verdict; a refused plan never executes). Default: on

plan_consensus.description: Cheap plan-soundness check before the waist (JSON sound/reasons; unsound forces the waist amend path; ledgered plan_consensus)

final_gate.description: Post-DAG final verification gate: false disables, true/auto uses a discovered/declared verify command, or pass an explicit command string

require_diff_authorization.description: An independent verifier model must allow the exact resulting content of every node write before it lands (default: on)

file.description: Optional source or target paths, all confined to root

stages.description: Subset of pipeline stages to execute (context, planning, execution, verification)

brief.description: Supplied context brief artifact or JSON pack file path inside root

token_budget_input.description: Override input token allowance ceiling for the composed run

token_budget_output.description: Override output token allowance ceiling for the composed run

allow_write.description: Confirm permission to write files when execute=true

tools.name: issue_sort
tools.title: Sort an issue into an operator-declared bucket
tools.description: JEV-P5 issue-sort: operator declares the bucket pack; code owns matching; TypeSafe choice criteria = operator labels only. Never invents buckets, path_ids, or suggested actions. Unkeyed / transport fail / out-of-pack → is_fallback with keyword match against pack keywords only; no match → bucket=null.

issue.description: Issue or deferral note text to sort

pack.description: Operator bucket pack: {id, buckets: {id: {label, kind: trouble_area|alternate_path|orchestration_driver, path_id, keywords[], suggested_next_action, attention}}}

tools.name: route_query
tools.title: Route a query onto the declared model ladder
tools.description: SITE-2 route marketplace: compares the request against the declared rung ladder (tier + cost class + observed evidence) and picks the cheapest capable rung. Choice criteria = declared rung ids only; never invents rungs or model ids. Unkeyed / transport fail / out-of-ladder → is_fallback with the code-owned tier heuristic; unsatisfiable floor → rung=null.

pack.description: Operator route pack: {id, rungs: [{rung_id, tier: T0|T1|T2|T3, model, cost_class: free|cheap|moderate|expensive|premium, observed_success?, samples?, guidance?, notes?}]}

tools.name: mission_status
tools.title: Mission pack status (read-only)
tools.description: Thin face over the HUL-A mission pack (harness.mission_record): regenerates STATUS.md/INDEX.md from on-disk pack state and returns the machine-readable summary (phase, dual budget, receipts, resume state). Read-only -- never mutates mission progress, spend, or resume status (same semantics as `harness mission status`).

tools.name: continue_work
tools.title: Resume a deferred/failed apply from its continuation state
tools.description: Thin face over the existing continue lane (the same engine.apply_batch(continuation=...) path `harness continue` and the UI's Continue pane use): resumes a gated apply from its saved continuation state. Write-gated exactly like apply_edit -- refuses without allow_write, and the continuation's target file must be inside an allowed root.

continuation.description: Saved continuation state from a deferred/failed apply_edit or `harness apply`

verify_cmd.description: Verify command override (requires server allow_verify; defaults to the continuation's own gate)

allow_verify.description: Explicit confirmation to run a verify gate in this request (required when allow_verify is not enabled server-side)

allow_write.description: Explicit confirmation that this MCP request may write files

tools.name: log_judgment
tools.title: Single-pass log-factor analysis against a frozen operator pack
tools.description: JEV-LOG: code extracts log items ($0), the ONE Jev policy owner judges every item (bucket choice + operator-declared score), and code aggregates the JSON artifact. Bucket ids and score levels come only from the operator pack; unmatched items stay unmatched; fallback counts are reported, never smoothed. Freeze the pack via operator approval before use.

pack.description: Frozen operator log pack: P5 bucket pack + one score block {id, instructions, levels[]}

info_sample.description: Also judge every Nth INFO record (0 = WARN/ERROR only)

tools.name: jev_phase
tools.title: JEV completion bar (local-only, read-only)
tools.description: Thin face over harness.jev_completion (the same engine `harness jev-phase --local-only` runs): hard gates + sentiment buckets score one phase or the whole board. Always local-only -- never calls a live Jev judge and never mutates STATUS or the repo.

repo_root.description: Workspace inside configured MCP allowed roots; defaults only when exactly one root is configured

phase.description: Phase id, e.g. DF-UI-2 (required unless 'all' is set)

tools.name: jev_freeze
tools.title: Freeze JEV model pin + confidence threshold
tools.description: Thin face over harness.config.freeze_jev_settings (the same owner the CLI `jev-freeze` command calls). A preview (persist=false, the default) reports the pin/threshold the freeze would apply and writes nothing; persist=true writes the operator config.json and requires allow_write. Refused fail-closed when the environment pins the same key, since the pin would not take effect.

model.description: Model id to pin (e.g. jev-1.13.0); omit to keep the current pin

min_confidence.description: Abstain/escalate threshold; omit to keep the current value

persist.description: Write the named keys into the operator config.json (requires allow_write)

allow_write.description: Explicit confirmation for a config write in this request

tools.name: dogfood
tools.title: Three-phase self-hosting dogfood audit and gated repair
tools.description: DF-UI-2 / HV-6: Run the self-hosting dogfood loop (ground -> verify -> apply) over claims and source window.

root.description: Selected workspace inside configured MCP allowed roots

file.description: Target file to repair under apply gate

verify.description: Verify gate command for apply phase

source_file.description: Path to source text window file

definitions_file.description: Optional path to definitions JSON file

allow_write.description: Confirm permission to write target file

tools.name: generate_brief
tools.title: Build an evidence-bearing context pack
tools.description: Generate a grounded context pack (HV-2 brief) for a goal from source files. Cites exact windows, estimates tokens, checks freshness, and tracks omissions. Hermetic: no network, no model call.

goal.description: High-level goal or instruction to brief

root.description: Selected workspace inside configured MCP allowed roots when source files are supplied

files.description: Source file paths to inspect and cite

budget.description: Maximum character budget for cited windows (default: 48000)

freshness.description: Evaluate and attach source freshness report

render.description: Render markdown prose representation instead of raw JSON

tools.name: driver_step
tools.title: Run verified extraction, Jev decision, and action step
tools.description: Execute a verified extraction -> Jev decision -> deterministic action step via driver-core. Consensus happens upstream of the decision. Returns an envelope with ok: true on execution or ok: false on a refusal (HTTP 200). Only transport failures raise.

target.description: Target window, process, URL or selector

by.description: Consent grantor label (default: the MCP peer, e.g. mcp:<client>). 'operator' needs allow_write=true

tools.name: driver_health
tools.title: Check driver-core service status and declared sources
tools.description: Query driver-core liveness, version, and declared perception sources.

tools.name: driver_vocabulary
tools.title: List driver-core declared action vocabulary
tools.description: Query driver-core closed 14-action vocabulary, tier mutability, and normalizers.

tools.name: driver_verify
tools.title: Verify cryptographic audit chain and spend budget
tools.description: Verify the hash-chain integrity of the driver audit log and return spend totals.

tools.name: host_provision_probe
tools.title: Probe host system facts for provisioning
tools.description: Probe host hardware, operating system, interpreter, GPU, and package managers (read-only facts).

tools.name: host_provision_plan
tools.title: Plan host provisioning for a goal
tools.description: Generate an ordered, typed host-provisioning Plan for a goal (dry-run/advisory only; consent required before execution).

root.description: Workspace inside configured MCP allowed roots; defaults only when exactly one root is configured

tools.name: repo_cards
tools.title: Repo philosophy cards generator/checker
tools.description: Generate or check deterministic repo philosophy cards from committed repository config.

root.description: Selected repo or parent workspace inside configured MCP allowed roots

check.description: True to verify cards match without writing (default)

allow_write.description: Explicit permission to write generated cards when check=false

tools.name: jev_calibration
tools.title: Jev judgment calibration analysis
tools.description: Analyze Jev judgment confidence distribution and recommend calibration threshold bands from ledger history (read-only).

window.description: Number of recent ledger entries to inspect

tools.name: economics_report
tools.title: Economics & value routing report
tools.description: Report tier snapshot freshness, seat-share diversity, per-lane/per-tier cost metering, and bounded pool-rotation proposals (read-only).

allow_cost_increase.description: Allow proposing a candidate with higher expected cost
